objective: Option 3: one linked BASIC/FOCAL program and a persistent VM session instead of repeated outer M61/OPEN dispatch

implementation.format: LVP1 version 1, little-endian, header and payload CRC32
implementation.members: Original independently validated LBV2 images; local branch addresses are unchanged. Raw LBV1 is host-compatibility only, rejected by wide-only APP configurations.
implementation.resources: Members must own their resource data; recipes requiring separately mutable source text are rejected.
implementation.execution: One linked outer loop, caller-provided numeric banks and operand stack, pointer-free continuation, dynamic next-symbol selection. The existing VM kernel still runs separately for each member; there is no new language CALL/RETURN syntax.
implementation.continuation: INPUT and step-budget yields resume in the current member, with fresh callbacks/readers. BASIC and FOCAL banks remain separate.
implementation.storage: Raw immutable image or paged reads. A changing epoch invalidates the session before any subsequent image access. No heap or static storage is allocated by the device-side layer.
implementation.source_identity: Bundle-local debug identity, not an installed C9 inode. Production editor integration requires an explicit manifest mapping.
implementation.unsupported: GRAPH expressions are explicitly rejected: ordinary VM graph cleanup is not resumable at arbitrary step/INPUT boundaries. This does not change the stock graphics path.
implementation.integration: No firmware entry point, C9 loader, M61 command or production cache policy has been changed. The offline container is an explicit compiled snapshot, not yet an automatically refreshed cache.

chess.alias: Symbols 4 and 5 share the legal.tbi image and source identity.
chess.equivalence: A/B/A exactly matches all 26 variable representations, 385 array representations including tags, 20 references, module order, event hash, poll and VM-run counts.
chess.timing_scope: Native host control with ASan/UBSan. Both routes use precompiled, prevalidated images; baseline does not recompile members. This does NOT measure M61, OPEN, device I/O, USB or hardware performance.
chess.timing_conclusion: No reproducible host speedup demonstrated. Hardware benefit remains unmeasured; the target overhead is absent from this control.
chess.run_note: The recorded chess run preceded the final cold-inspection epoch guard and builder overwrite protection. Accepted-member execution, VM arithmetic and chess sources were unchanged by these final safety-only changes.

storage_accounting.note: These are separately accounted caller-owned objects, not a verified production RAM placement or measured RAM saving. Bindings, services, paged-I/O state and native stack also require storage.

arm_object.compiler: arm-none-eabi GCC 14.2.1, Cortex-M4 hard-float, -Os, no LTO, MK61_BUILD_LANGUAGE_VM_MODULE
arm_object.note: Standalone object containing cold validation and hot execution. NOT a linked APP/resident delta, not a production Flash/RAM/stack qualification.

tests.unit: PASS: both arithmetic backends, host and wide-only APP configurations, ASan/UBSan. Raw/paged images, BASIC/FOCAL bank isolation, INPUT, budgets, ESC, errors/line mapping, callback forwarding, freed-image invalidation, malformed/truncated containers and >64 KiB member with dynamic jump.
tests.strict_compiler_control: PASS: the same four unit configurations with Homebrew Clang 18.1.8, -Wall -Wextra -Werror, sanitizers disabled.
tests.builder: PASS: BASIC/FOCAL, aliases, Cyrillic and quoted paths, CRC/layout, rejected manifests preserving the old output, source/manifest/symlink/hardlink overwrite protection.
tests.chess: PASS: actual unchanged 24-source search, both arithmetic backends, ordinary-member/linked/ordinary-member A/B/A.

actual_arm.configuration: Actual Cortex-M4 code in Unicorn, wide-only VM, native EABI, -nostdlib, no external runtime libraries
actual_arm.matrix: Raw/paged x aligned/+1 unaligned x unlimited/7-step budget
actual_arm.checks: BASIC -> FOCAL -> BASIC, INPUT, dynamic GOTO, exact expected banks; continuation moved between addresses and old copy poisoned at every yield; image bytes unchanged; writes bounded to fixture globals and stack.
actual_arm.note: Bare fixture, not a production APP, keyboard/USB latency test or hardware timing.

tests.whole_repository_suite: Not run; focused new-layer tests were run.

production_constraints.consequence: Do not simply link the whole new layer into LANGVM. First separate cold container validation/loading from hot session execution and remove replaced M61/OPEN/setup paths; measure the final linked budgets.

next: Integrate the linked session with real M61/OPEN and overlay services without linking a second VM into resident firmware or silently changing arbitrary autoexec.m61 semantics.
Map bundle identities to source/editor records; define dependency fingerprints and rebuild/invalidation rules for changed BASIC/FOCAL sources.
Place catalog/session in existing reusable workspace and enforce the unchanged final APP, resident Flash, RAM and stack gates.
Run both arithmetic backends and physical Classic A/B/A, including complete board output, cold/warm behavior and keyboard/USB latency before deciding whether to ship.
